The axis DOES apply to React (it's a valid rendering-strategy question for any UI framework) — React just fails it: it explicitly uses virtual-DOM diffing/reconciliation, the opposite of what the story asks for. Unambiguous none, and a useful contrast case against the na cells above (applicable axis, product doesn't deliver, vs. axis genuinely inapplicable).
